text:
Jiwoo Park: Hi everyone! Im Jiwoo (they/them) joining Eng-Platform today. Day-one checklist: MDM enrollment, building badge pickup, GitHub write access, and who to ping about small GPU quota for local perf tests. Fun fact: I build tiny glass terrariums and bring one to stand on my desk. :seedling::earth_asia:
Maya G.: welcome Jiwoo!! :wave: I'm on Eng-Platform too. Buddy is @Priya R.  she'll grab you for a 10m intro in ~20m. Badge pickup is reception (bring ID).
Priya R.: hey Jiwoo  invite sent. I'll cover Slack channels, code of conduct, and the 1-day checklist. Also will ship you a sticker pack if you like plants.
Jiwoo Park: amazing, thanks Priya! Quick Q re: MDM - I haven't seen the Jamf invite yet. Anything to run while I wait?
IT Bot: Automated: New user detected. MDM invite will be sent to your corporate email within 30 minutes. If you don't receive it, run `check_mdm_status` or open a ticket at it-support@redwood.com.
Oliver H.: if Jamf email missing, try resending from the self-service portal: https://redwood/internal/mdm/resend. Also verify your corp email alias.
Jiwoo Park: got Jamf email and enrolling now. Also adding SSH key - is ed25519 still preferred?
Maya G.: yes ed25519 preferred. Add pub key at https://github.com/orgs/redwood/settings/keys then test with `ssh -T git@github.com`.
Jiwoo Park: ssh test passed. For local smoke runs, where's the tiny model script?
Priya R.: onboarding repo has it: https://gitlab.redwood/onboarding/dev-smoke `./run_local_smoke.sh`  it fires up a small dockerized server and runs a few prompts. If docker perms fail run `sudo usermod -aG docker $USER` and re-login.
DevEx Bot: Tip: If you need to simulate longer sequences, use `SMOKE_SEQ_LEN=1024 ./run_local_smoke.sh`. Beware memory on smaller dev machines.
Jiwoo Park: perfect. Last tiny thing - GPU quota request: who handles that? I just need 8GB for short perf checks.
Oliver H.: open an internal resource request at https://redwood/internal/resource-requests and tag `gpu` + expected memory and duration. Platform triages in 2-3 biz days for low priority. For quicker access ask infra-sre for ephemeral dev pods.
HR Bot: Reminder: benefits enrollment due in 30 days. Link: https://redwood/hr/benefits.
Jiwoo Park: thanks all! Lunch preferences: coffee black or oat latte, allergic to peanuts. Bringing a terrarium to show if anyone wants to see. :)
Maya G.: oat latte + terrarium show pls. Welcome aboard! :tada:
(Reaction summary: Priya R. :wave: on intro, Maya G. :thumbsup:, Oliver H. :party: )
